fieldData.acrm---key-feature-1-content:
One statement per part of the job

Emergent writes a satisfaction item for each topic you name, such as pay, benefits or your schedule. Add a topic later and it gets an item in the survey and a row in the results.
fieldData.acrm---key-feature-6-content:
Your survey as code in GitHub

Export the survey, its response tables, and its dashboards to your GitHub on paid plans. Run it on your own servers, edit the code by hand or keep prompting Emergent for changes.
fieldData.awb---integration-feature-1:
Night shift gets its own staffing score

Nurses on every unit answer a nurse satisfaction survey of 18 questions on staffing, scheduling and patient load. Results split by unit and by day or night shift. When fewer than half of one shift on a unit are satisfied with staffing, the unit's nurse manager gets an email with the counts and comments.
fieldData.awb---mockup-data: window.awbMockup = { wholeCompany: "Build an employee satisfaction survey for my company of 350 people. Use 30 questions on seven topics, including pay, benefits, my managers, workload and schedules, on a 1-5 scale from very dissatisfied to very satisfied. Keep it open 10 days and remind only people who have not answered. Show each topic's percent satisfied with its comments beside it.", nursingUnits: "Build a satisfaction survey for the nurses in my hospital. Ask 18 questions on staffing, scheduling and patient load. Tag every response with the unit and with day or night shift from our roster. If fewer than half of a shift on any unit are satisfied with staffing, email that unit's nurse manager the counts and the comments.", schoolDistrict: "Build a staff satisfaction survey for the teachers and support staff at the nine schools in my district. Use one link and tag each response to its school. Each principal should see only their own school's results, and the district office should see all nine. Hide results for any school with fewer than five answers, and rank the items district-wide.", remoteVsOffice: "Build a workplace satisfaction survey for my remote and office staff with 12 questions on workspace, equipment, software, and focus time. Show both groups in adjacent columns on one dashboard. Turn the remote staff's equipment comments into a list of requests for our IT lead, counted and sorted by how often each one comes up." };
fieldData.awb---how-to-step-4-des: Say who gets the survey, which topics it covers and how long it stays open, and include the privacy rule. Emergent builds the survey with its response table and dashboards from that description.
